CFML Language Reference: Functions

DaysInYear

Returns the length of the year in which a date falls.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DaysInYear(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one. Only its year matters.

Returns

365, or 366 for a leap year.

Usage

The argument is a date, not a year number: DaysInYear(2000) would treat 2000 as a day count, not as the year

  1. Pass CreateDate(2000, 1, 1) instead, or use IsLeapYear with a plain year number.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Year</TH><TH>DaysInYear</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="Y" LIST="1900,1996,1999,2000">
<TR><TD>#Y#</TD><TD>#DaysInYear(CreateDate(Y, 1, 1))#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

DaysInMonth, IsLeapYear, DayOfYear
